```{r}
wineData = read.csv("~/STAT394-Group-Project/extracted data.csv", header=TRUE)
summary(wineData)
```
```{r}
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
wineData$Cultivar = c(rep("Mencia",20),rep("Alicante Bouschet",10))
wineMelt = melt(wineData[,-c(1,2)],
                id.vars = "Cultivar",
                variable.name = "Measure")
ggplot(data=wineMelt, aes(x=Measure, y=value)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(col=Measure), notch = FALSE) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_grid(~Cultivar) +
  ylab("Values")
```

```{r}
apply(wineData[1:20,3:25],2,shapiro.test)
```

First try PCA on whole dataset, look for cultivar separation.

```{r}
wineDataVariables = wineData[,3:25]


wineDataPCA = prcomp(wineDataVariables, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)$x

summary(prcomp(wineDataVariables, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
# first 5 PCs have stdev>1, drop rest
wineDataPCA = wineDataPCA[,1:5]
summary(wineDataPCA)
wineDataPCADF = as.data.frame(wineDataPCA)
apply(wineDataPCADF[1:20,],2,shapiro.test)

```
```{r}
# mahalanobis to find surprising obs from model assuming no groups
PCAMahalanobis = mahalanobis(wineDataPCADF,center = colMeans(wineDataPCADF),cov = cov(wineDataPCADF))
PCAMahalanobis
surprise = pchisq(PCAMahalanobis,df=5,lower.tail = FALSE)
surprise
surpriseFull = ifelse(surprise <= 0.01, "Very Surprising",
                      ifelse(surprise <= 0.05, "Surprising",
                             ifelse(surprise <= 0.1, "Slightly Surprising", round(surprise,4))))
surpriseFull
```
```{r}
# check if AB obs are consistent with M distribution
PCAFullMenciaMahal = mahalanobis(wineDataPCADF, center=colMeans(wineDataPCADF[1:20,]), cov=cov(wineDataPCADF[1:20,]))
PCAFullMenciaMahal
surpriseMencia = pchisq(PCAFullMenciaMahal, df=5, lower.tail=FALSE)
surpriseMenciaWords = ifelse(surpriseMencia <= 0.01, "Very Surprising",
                      ifelse(surpriseMencia <= 0.05, "Surprising",
                             ifelse(surpriseMencia <= 0.1, "Slightly Surprising", round(surprise,4))))
surpriseMenciaWords
```
```{r}
# check if M obs are consistent with AB distribution
PCAFullAlicanteMahal = mahalanobis(wineDataPCADF, center=colMeans(wineDataPCADF[21:30,]), cov=cov(wineDataPCADF[21:30,]))
PCAFullAlicanteMahal
surpriseAlicante = pchisq(PCAFullAlicanteMahal, df=5, lower.tail=FALSE)
surpriseAlicanteWords = ifelse(surpriseAlicante <= 0.01, "Very Surprising",
                      ifelse(surpriseAlicante <= 0.05, "Surprising",
                             ifelse(surpriseAlicante <= 0.1, "Slightly Surprising", round(surprise,4))))
surpriseAlicanteWords
```
